title: Require Repository Separation Predecessor Source Absence
forbids: source-spelled, unescaped static ES-style import and re-export specifiers that exactly name a task-2.11 predecessor package identity or subpath
why: Repository separation leaves Habitat source dependent only on current Habitat owners and released interfaces. This parser-visible law owns only the direct source-spelling relation; project-owned TypeScript checks own cooked or escaped module resolution and TypeScript import-equals.
remediate: Import from the current Habitat owner or remove the obsolete dependency. Do not add an alias, shim, fallback, or copied predecessor path.
message: Habitat JavaScript and TypeScript source must not use a source-spelled predecessor identity in a static ES-style import or re-export specifier.
